summary: Refactor NextOne Flutter app: remove flutter_hooks/HookWidget, migrate to StatefulWidget where local state is needed, consolidate monorepo packages (nextone_core + models) into lib/ using Clean Architecture layers, and remove auto_mappr in favour of direct mapping.

data/.models/: Freezed models (API responses, DTOs — moved from packages/models)

domain/.entities/: Pure Dart domain entities (User, Artist, Track)
domain/.repositories/: Domain-level repository interfaces (if different from data layer)

application/.music_player/: MusicPlayerBloc, events, states (if not yet present)

lib/.presentation/: All page and widget files (current structure retained)

subtasks.title: Consolidate packages into lib/
subtasks.scope: Move all Dart source from packages/nextone_core/lib/src/ and packages/models/lib/src/ into lib/. Update all import paths. Remove packages/ directory. Update root pubspec.yaml to remove local package path dependencies.
steps: Copy packages/models/lib/src/ → lib/data/models/ (api_responses, dto) and lib/data/mappers/
Copy packages/nextone_core/lib/src/application/ → lib/application/
Copy packages/nextone_core/lib/src/services/ → lib/data/services/
Copy packages/nextone_core/lib/src/repositories/ → lib/data/repositories/
Copy packages/nextone_core/lib/src/injection/ → lib/core/injection/
Delete packages/ directory
Update root pubspec.yaml: remove 'nextone_core' and 'models' path dependencies, absorb their dependencies directly
Run global find-and-replace on all lib/ imports: replace 'package:nextone_core/' and 'package:models/' with 'package:nextone/'
Verify no broken imports remain
acceptance_criteria: flutter pub get succeeds with no package resolution errors
No import references package:nextone_core or package:models

subtasks.title: Replace auto_mappr with manual mappers
subtasks.scope: Remove auto_mappr and auto_mappr_annotation. Write plain Dart extension methods or static factory constructors for each mapper that was generated.

mappers_to_replace.approach: ArtistDto.fromApiResponse(ArtistApiResponse response) factory constructor or extension on ArtistApiResponse

steps: Read each *.auto_mappr.dart generated file to understand current field mappings
Write fromApiResponse factory constructor or toDto() extension for each mapper
Update repository/service files that call mapper methods to use new pattern
Remove auto_mappr and auto_mappr_annotation from all pubspec.yaml files
Delete *.auto_mappr.dart generated files
Run dart analyze to confirm no missing references
acceptance_criteria: No auto_mappr imports anywhere in lib/
All DTO conversions compile and return correct types

subtasks.title: Convert HookWidget pages to StatefulWidget
subtasks.scope: Replace all 8 HookWidget usages with StatelessWidget or StatefulWidget. Move local state to StatefulWidget state. TextEditingControllers go in State with initState/dispose lifecycle.

hook_replacements.useTextEditingController() for email: TextEditingController in State, dispose in dispose()
hook_replacements.useTextEditingController() for password: TextEditingController in State, dispose in dispose()
hook_replacements.useState<bool>(false) for passwordVisibl: _passwordVisible bool field in State, setState() on toggle

files_to_convert.bloc_access: Keep context.watch<AuthBloc>() via BlocBuilder, context.read<AuthBloc>() stays unchanged

hook_replacements.useTextEditingController(): TextEditingController fields in State with dispose

hook_replacements.useState<String?>() for selectedRole: _selectedRole String? in State, setState() on change

hook_replacements.useEffect() with Timer: Timer in initState(), cancel in dispose()

hook_replacements.useTextEditingController() as fallback: Internal TextEditingController if none provided, disposed in dispose()
hook_replacements.useEffect() with controller listener: addListener in initState(), removeListener in dispose()

files_to_convert.note: Accepts optional external TextEditingController param; if null, creates own internally

migration_pattern.stateful_template: class MyPage extends StatefulWidget { const MyPage({super.key}); @override State<MyPage> createState() => _MyPageState(); } class _MyPageState extends State<MyPage> { late final TextEditingController _ctrl; @override void initState() { super.initState(); _ctrl = TextEditingController(); } @override void dispose() { _ctrl.dispose(); super.dispose(); } @override Widget build(BuildContext context) { ... } }
migration_pattern.bloc_access: BlocBuilder<AuthBloc, AuthState> and BlocListener<AuthBloc, AuthState> replace context.watch(). context.read<AuthBloc>().add() stays identical.

acceptance_criteria: Zero imports of flutter_hooks in lib/
All TextEditingControllers are disposed in State.dispose()
All pages render correctly with same visual output
